items.text: Smart collection sync — inline edit and delete from smart-collection rows update the canonical bookmark on the page and allBookmarks; note and tags stay in sync across columns; delete undo restores the global view too.
Inline delete confirm — delete from the inline editor no longer conflicts with click-outside handlers; the confirm modal stacks above the editor with correct focus.
Discard confirm modal — unsaved inline-edit dismiss uses AppModal instead of a native browser dialog.
Reorder flush — debounced bookmark reorder persists immediately on page switch or tab hide (mirrors category-order flush).
Page rename errors — failed page-tab rename rolls back the local name and shows a localized error toast.
Neutral grid on page switch — keyboard selection clears on page change unless you were already navigating with the keyboard.
G chord — G then 1–9 jumps to a category only; it no longer switches pages or feeds into shortcut search.
Search overlay guards — >, :, ?, +, and & are blocked while page overview, omnibox, inline edit, tag cloud, or other modals are open.
Search ghost overlay — rebuilding shortcuts after a page switch or reorder closes an open search UI instead of leaving a stale overlay.
Page shortcuts vs search — 1–9 and Shift+←/→ no longer change pages while the search overlay is active.
Delete on smart rows — the Delete key resolves the bookmark by URL/reference (same as ;) so it works on smart-collection copies.
Mac shortcuts — Cmd+C copies the selected URL; Cmd+Home / Cmd+End jump to the first/last bookmark on the page.
Swipe & omnibox guards — horizontal swipes and keyboard grid navigation respect isModalOpen() (page overview, omnibox, app modal).
Paste during tag cloud — Ctrl+V quick-add paste is ignored while the tag word cloud is open.
Page overview — desktop close button; focus returns to the trigger; list wraps at the ends; visible page names use locale fallbacks.
Omnibox focus — closing the quick-add omnibox restores keyboard focus to the prior control.
Search input a11y — mobile search field and bookmark grid use data-i18n-aria labels in EN / NL / DE / FR.

Cache-bust — whats-new-v63 data version and 2026.06-dashboard-release-v57 dashboard release token; dashboard.js, keyboard-navigation.js, search.js, and dashboard.css query strings updated for Docker-mounted static files.
